title: Count values above a cut
learning_goal: Translate a numerical selection into a precise C++ condition and count the values that survive it.
summary: Practice the core analysis operation: apply a threshold and count what survives.
description: Implement int count_above(const std::vector<double>& values, double threshold). Count values strictly greater than threshold.
requirements: Use a strict > comparison: a value equal to the threshold does not pass.
Do not modify the input vector.
hints: Start the counter at 0 and increment only when value > threshold.
The threshold is already a function argument; do not hard-code it.
